messages:
Maya: Quick sync  need a benchmark narrative for the webinar (latency vs token cost). Key constraints: no absolute claims, must show workload context, include routing playbook. Deliverables: 1 one-pager, 3 visuals, 2 social drafts, routing matrix. Who volunteers?
Omar: Ill do the data pulls and include per-workload percentiles. Thinking visuals: 1) small-multiples latency lines (dialogue, retrieval, summarization) showing P50/P95; 2) tokens->$ waterfall (baseline vs batching vs cache); 3) a compact decision flow showing routing by SLO and cost tier.
Priya: Tone: "predictable economics" + "sensible fallbacks." Two hero lines to test: A) "Predictable inference economics for production teams." B) "Keep latency SLOs, lower token spend where it matters." Which reads better?
Sam: I prefer B for the landing page. Bolder. I'll prepare slide comps with horizontal triptych so it crops for socials. Color: deep teal + warm amber for tail callouts.
Omar: Quick sample query (pseudo):
```
-- P95 by workload and model
SELECT workload, model, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95
FROM requests_30d
GROUP BY workload, model;
```
Ill attach CSVs. Using "up to" ranges for percent savings.
Priya: Social variants: engineer (short): "See three real workloads  latency vs token economics. Wed 11am PT. Register:" executive (longer): "Benchmarks and playbooks to reduce inference spend while preserving latency SLOs  live demo + routing playbook." 20-word blurb: "Benchmarks and tactics to reduce inference spend without breaking latency SLOs  real workloads, routing playbook, and actionables."
LegalBot: Please add methodology appendix with definitions (P50/P95), sample sizes, time window. Any absolute % claims must cite data row.
Maya: Good call. Omar include appendix CSV + short methodology note. Priya use conservative language in the hero and social. Sam add tiny appendix callout on the one-pager.
Sam: Will also add small inset explaining how the tokens->$ calc works (cost_per_token assumptions + batching impact).
Omar: Timeline: CSVs by EOD today, Sam mocks by tomorrow AM, Priya final copy tomorrow EOD. Ill label rows by workload so Legal can review.
Maya: Routing matrix (short): if intent_score >= 75 AND api_key_created -> AE follow-up; intent >= 40 -> nurture drip and playbook email; trial-signups -> product tour. Ally Ops to wire UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_parity&utm_seg={seg}.
Priya: Also: do not use the word "parity" in public copy. Might confuse. Maybe use "balanced economics" for internal name.
Maya: Noted. Final checklist: data CSVs (Omar), comps (Sam), copy (Priya), appendix (Omar), routing doc + UTM table (Maya). Meeting to finalize Fri 10am PT. Thanks team :rocket:
